## Experience
- Front-End Developer, Pardazeshgaran Sepehr, July 2023–present: built and maintained front ends across 15+ healthcare, pharmacy, insurance and cybersecurity products; reusable components, role-based workflows and responsive PWAs.
- Robotics Instructor, SIGMA Educational Company, July 2021–June 2023: Arduino, Scratch and mBlock teaching; judged national robotics competitions at the University of Tehran.

## Technical Skills
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, RESTful APIs, Axios, i18next and RTL/LTR.
- Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, React Hook Form and Zod.
- Tailwind CSS, Ant Design, Framer Motion, React Flow, Recharts, Highcharts and Leaflet.
- PWA, Service Workers, Socket.IO and Server-Sent Events (SSE).
- Testing: Vitest. Familiar with React Testing Library and Cypress.
- Git, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Vite, Figma and Chrome DevTools. Familiar with Zustand.

## Projects
- Ganotic: https://ganotic.ir — health and wellness e-commerce; Next.js PWA storefront with Persian RTL, React admin panel, order management, catalog filtering, payment integration and a Figma design system.
- MSSP: https://mssp.inhso.ir — managed security services; administrator, customer and SOC workspaces, security dashboards, TanStack Query API caching and pagination, and Vitest tests for API services and authentication.
- PicoPet: https://picopet.ir — veterinary care; appointments, pet medical records, role-based interfaces, Persian/English localization and TanStack Query caching.
- Salam: https://inhso.ir/ — Ministry of Health national platform; Jalali booking, filterable specialist directories with infinite loading and map discovery, patient records and medical charts, text consultations, meeting/payment APIs and SSE browser alerts through Service Workers.
- Sepehr Pharmacy: https://pharmacy.isikato.ir/drgharaee — pharmacy management and e-commerce; product and prescription checkout, inventory tools, real-time updates and PWA installation/update flows.
- Sepehr Salamat (INHS): https://inhs.isikato.ir — medical center and cancer pathway system; multi-insurer e-prescriptions, appointments, patient records and interactive React Flow treatment pathways.
- Payesh: https://payesh.inhso.ir/login — occupational health monitoring platform.

## Additional Frontend Projects
- Cancermed: https://cancermed.inhso.ir/ — precision oncology; contributions to doctor-profile and appointment-booking interfaces, and the PWA installation flow.
- 4040: Integrated SSO callbacks and guarded patient routes with validated post-login destinations. Developed paginated prescription history and medical charts with typed API integration.
- Salam Admin: Implemented provider verification, role-upgrade and account-restriction interfaces. Developed support-ticket conversations and application-log inspection with typed API integration.
- Consultation Admin: Developed filtered, paginated views for consultation orders, cancellations and meeting-link failures. Integrated meeting-link retry actions with cache invalidation and provider-category management.
- Document Management: Implemented versioned document/media uploads, categorized search and per-user access-management interfaces. Integrated attachment handling and ZIP downloads through document-management APIs.
- Hub Panel: Developed role-specific workspaces for service catalogs, client assignments and service requests. Integrated API-driven operational charts, reports and downloadable service documentation.
- Laboratory Management: Implemented electronic and paper prescription workflows across insurance providers. Developed laboratory-result upload, review and patient-facing retrieval interfaces.
- Paraclinic Management: https://paraclinic.isikato.ir/home — Developed multi-insurer prescription inquiry, service selection and submission workflows. Integrated insurance-specific service search, attachment uploads and cached API queries.
- Pharmacy Aggregator: https://pharmacy.isikato.ir/ — Implemented prescription reservation and order-tracking workflows across patient, operator and pharmacy-supervisor panels. Developed pharmacy discovery with maps, paginated loading and normalized API responses.
- Specialized Pharmacy Aggregator: Implemented specialized prescription submission and pharmacy-reservation interfaces with role-specific panels. Integrated operator/supervisor management and cache invalidation after prescription mutations.
- Pardazeshgaran Sepehr Website: https://picsepehr.com/ — Developed article-publishing interfaces with rich-text editing and media uploads. Implemented localized route metadata and responsive product, article and company-information pages.
- Registration Portal: https://mokamel.isikato.ir/ — Implemented applicant profiles, family-information forms and supporting-document submission workflows. Developed administrator monitoring with chart drill-downs, filtered user lists and account controls.
- Training Management: Developed course, training-run and contract-management interfaces within organization-specific workspaces. Integrated Zod-validated APIs, CSRF-token handling and recovery from active-assignment changes.
- Education Workspace — Demo: Built a bilingual training-management demo with validated course planning and browser-local persistence. Implemented learner histories, CSV export and printable records using shared course/enrollment data.

These descriptions concern frontend contributions. Supplied backend repositories are not claimed as backend development work. The Education Workspace is a browser-local demo.
